# SCI-NOI v0.1 — Scientific-Owner ODQ-110C Approval

Decision identity: `SCI-NOI-ODQ-110C`

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Decision date: `2026-08-30`

Status: approved FRUIT ownership, fixed-state, successor-generation, and
relearning policy

## Exact Owner Decision

FRUIT owns its source model, subtraction and add-back, learned state,
recurrence, iteration, stopping, restart, selection, response, support,
validity, lifecycle, and failure semantics. NOI does not choose, define, tune,
or scientifically reinterpret any of them.

An exact immutable FRUIT residual or terminal transformed scientific product
may support conditional uncertainty estimation when FRUIT supplies its exact
parent and owner-defined transformation interface. NOI must apply exactly that
declared fixed FRUIT transformation to every admitted compatible randomization.
The result is conditional on the frozen FRUIT state and does not include
variation from learning or selecting that state.

Replaying some or all of FRUIT separately for each realization is a distinct
ODQ-104 relearned method. If an NOI product informs a later FRUIT iteration,
the later FRUIT state, scientific product, GEN, and UNC form a new immutable
successor generation. Fixed-state and relearned FRUIT members cannot be mixed
in one uncertainty estimate without a separately authorized mixture estimand.

## Fixed Residual Or Terminal Transformation

For a fixed-state method, FRUIT supplies the exact immutable residual or
terminal scientific product plus complete source-model, subtraction/add-back,
learned-state, recurrence-generation, stopping/selection, parent, operation-
order, domain/support/edge/missing-data, normalization/unit/response, validity,
lifecycle, and failure identity required to reproduce its transformation on
compatible randomizations.

NOI owns only its ensemble/uncertainty method identity, exact binding to that
FRUIT authority, conforming application to admitted randomizations, and
truthful product scope and limitations. If the fixed transformation cannot be
identified and applied with exact parity, the route is unavailable.

The resulting uncertainty applies only to the exact fixed FRUIT residual or
terminal transformed product. It does not include source-model uncertainty,
learning/iteration variation, convergence or selection variation, restart
variation, unmodeled residual bias, or source leakage except where a separately
authorized method explicitly targets and estimates such variation.

## NOI-Informed Successor FRUIT Generation

If FRUIT uses an NOI product to continue, select, restart, or otherwise update
its procedure, the immutable successor graph is

```text
UNC_k -> FRUIT_OWNER:LearnIterate_(k+1) -> F_(k+1)
science_parent -> F_(k+1) -> fruit_science_(k+1)
GEN_base_(k+1) -> F_(k+1) -> GEN_fruit_(k+1) -> UNC_(k+1)
```

The exact prior NOI input, FRUIT target, source model, fitting population,
dependence, recurrence, learned state, stopping/restart/selection, response,
support, failure, and lifecycle are FRUIT-owned method identity. `UNC_k` remains
immutable and is a dependent input, not independent evidence validating
`F_(k+1)` or `UNC_(k+1)`. The successor cannot mutate or retroactively validate
the prior product. Reusing assignments or other numerical content does not
merge generations or establish independence.

## Per-Realization FRUIT Replay

Partial or complete FRUIT replay for each realization is a separately named
ODQ-104 relearned method. It must identify every scientifically consequential
rerun/relearned stage and member-specific state, including source-model update,
subtraction/add-back, recurrence, stopping, restart, selection, response,
support, failure, and terminal product. “FRUIT-relearned” alone is not a
complete method definition.

Fixed-residual, fixed-terminal-transform, partial-replay, and complete-replay
members remain separate. They cannot be silently pooled or substituted.

## Availability And Claim Boundary

No numerical fixed, successor, partial-replay, or complete-replay FRUIT route
is admitted by this decision alone. Every route remains unavailable until
SCI-FRUIT or another exact FRUIT-owning scientific authority supplies the
required parent/transformation or inference/relearning contract and the
corresponding NOI boundary is content-bound.

This approval establishes no FRUIT validity, source recovery, source
cancellation, residual unbiasedness, independence, covariance completeness,
calibration, significance, implementation conformity, performance, readiness,
or production authorization.
